description: State feature schema for Adaptive Verification Controller (AVC)

actions.name: FAST_PATH_DECISION
actions.description: Immediate deterministic Tier-1 or ambiguity-guard verdict

actions.name: CHEAP_VERIFICATION
actions.description: Execute fine-tuned MiniLM NLI cross-encoder on retrieved evidence

actions.name: COUNTER_EVIDENCE_RETRIEVAL
actions.description: Formulate targeted counter-query and retrieve falsifying context

actions.name: EXPENSIVE_LLM_ESCALATION
actions.description: Escalate to frozen C0 llama3.2 zero-shot generative NLI verifier

actions.name: EPISTEMIC_ABSTENTION
actions.description: Abstain with NOT_ESTABLISHED for out-of-domain or ungroundable claims

actions.name: MULTI_EVIDENCE_CONSENSUS
actions.description: Arbitrate between primary and counter-evidence using cheap NLI and heuristics

query.name: query_token_count
query.description: Number of whitespace-delimited tokens in query

query.name: query_is_question
query.description: 1.0 if query ends with ? or starts with interrogative, else 0.0

query.name: query_has_universal_quantifier
query.description: 1.0 if query contains universal quantifiers (all, every, always, never, none), else 0.0

query.name: query_clause_count
query.description: Count of punctuation and coordinating conjunction clauses

retrieval.name: retrieval_top_score
retrieval.description: Similarity score of the top-ranked retrieved evidence chunk

retrieval.name: retrieval_margin_top2
retrieval.description: Difference between top chunk score and second chunk score

retrieval.name: retrieval_chunk_count
retrieval.description: Number of retrieved chunks in context window

retrieval.name: retrieval_avg_chunk_length
retrieval.description: Average character length of retrieved chunks

retrieval.name: retrieval_distinct_sources
retrieval.description: Number of unique document source files in retrieved context

evidence_sufficiency.name: evidence_entity_overlap
evidence_sufficiency.description: Jaccard lexical overlap between content tokens in query and evidence

evidence_sufficiency.name: evidence_negation_count
evidence_sufficiency.description: Count of negation keywords in evidence text

evidence_sufficiency.name: evidence_epistemic_coherence
evidence_sufficiency.description: Degree of overlap between query predicates and evidence assertion sentences

evidence_sufficiency.name: evidence_contradiction_signal
evidence_sufficiency.description: Presence of conflicting polarity lexemes between claim and evidence

cheap_verifier.name: cheap_nli_p_contradiction
cheap_verifier.description: Softmax probability of CONTRADICTION from fine-tuned MiniLM

cheap_verifier.name: cheap_nli_p_entailment
cheap_verifier.description: Softmax probability of ENTAILMENT from fine-tuned MiniLM

cheap_verifier.name: cheap_nli_p_neutral
cheap_verifier.description: Softmax probability of NEUTRAL from fine-tuned MiniLM

cheap_verifier.name: cheap_nli_winning_conf
cheap_verifier.description: Highest class probability from cheap verifier

cheap_verifier.name: cheap_nli_margin_top2
cheap_verifier.description: Difference between highest and second highest class probability

cheap_verifier.name: cheap_nli_entropy
cheap_verifier.description: Normalized Shannon entropy of probability distribution

discrete_state.name: state_code
discrete_state.description: Categorical evidence state index (0 to 5 for E0..E5)
